summary: Opened a new sourced question and recorded a source-only account for a bounded completion gap distinct from the context-substitution defect. When a leader has no committed entry in its current term, handleLeaderReadIndex rejects a follower-forwarded ReadIndex and calls reportDroppedReadIndex, which appends the forwarded context to the leader's own update; node.processDroppedReadIndexes then feeds those contexts to pendingReadIndex.dropped, which only completes batches keyed by that context on the leader. The originating node is never told, so its client waits for the caller deadline instead of observing ErrClusterNotReady, while a locally admitted read in the same state does get the dropped result. The trigger is legal and recurrent — the window after an election before the new leader's no-op commits — and the account states the implied repair of reporting the drop back to the originating node, with the deadline bound, source-only basis and untraced rejection branches as limits. Added four source ranges, a behavior entry, the new investigation and its interpretation. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false. No execution was run.
